# Hornbostel–Sachs number

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hsNumber`](gmeow-hsNumber.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hsNumber>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

The Hornbostel–Sachs classification number for this instrument type, as a literal string (e.g. "314.122-4-8" for piano). Optional; carried as a literal because HS codes are not quantitative values ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:InstrumentType`](../classes/gmeow-InstrumentType.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string); functional
